events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a massive happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman, known for hits like 'Brass in Pocket' and 'Don't Get Me Wrong', continues to be a true rock legend. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, and celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mancunian Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: You know the voice, you know the attitude! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. From Oasis anthems to his brilliant solo work, he's still got it. What's your top Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single on October 11, 1971, from his album of the same name, which came out on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine' a better world. The timeless anthem, officially released as a single on October 11, 1971, still resonates deeply today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Quarter Century
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple dropped the original device, changing how we listened to music forever. The click wheel, the white earbuds... pure nostalgia! What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) because it's Global James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, what's your favourite Bond film or iconic theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python's silly walks to the chaotic charm of Basil Fawlty, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'! A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed the Fab Four at their most experimental. What's your hidden gem from this iconic double LP?

events.title: 35th anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead vocalist of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, due to complications from AIDS.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true icon. His unparalleled talent and stage presence continue to captivate millions. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul at 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released the groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul'. This album marked a pivotal shift in their sound, blending folk and pop with lyrical depth. What's your standout track?

events.title: 46th anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, outside his New York City apartment at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy as a musician, activist, and voice for peace remains as powerful as ever. We're remembering his incredible life and work today.
